description:
This figure contains three plots showing the accuracy of a model trained with differential privacy on the CIFAR-10 dataset. Each plot corresponds to a different ε value (2, 4, 8). The blue line represents training accuracy, and the red line represents testing accuracy. The highest accuracy is achieved with ε=8, reaching approximately 73%. The lowest accuracy is with ε=2, around 67%. The plots also show the delta value, which is the probability of violating privacy. The delta value increases with more epochs.
